courses.title: Build REST APIs with FastAPI
courses.why: Miki Tebeka's short, current course on building REST API servers with FastAPI and making them production ready: the one FastAPI-specific course on LinkedIn Learning, and an exact match for this path.

courses.title: Advanced Python: Practical Database Examples
courses.why: Hands-on database projects in Python, including a lesson that integrates a database with a FastAPI application: the data-access half of this path (SQLAlchemy, transactions, an API over a database).

portals.name: FastAPI Tutorial – User Guide (official)
portals.what: The official step-by-step guide: path and query parameters, request bodies, dependencies, security, and testing, each with runnable examples.

portals.name: DataCamp: FastAPI interview questions
portals.what: A beginner-to-advanced guide with scenario questions, noting what junior versus senior interviews focus on (dependency injection, middleware, connection pools).

portals.name: roadmap.sh: Backend developer interview questions
portals.what: 50 backend questions (HTTP, APIs, caching, databases, auth) in beginner, intermediate and advanced sets: the API-design side of this path.

assessments.name: HackerRank Rest API (Intermediate) certificate
assessments.format: 90-minute online test, 2 problems on consuming and processing REST APIs; one attempt only, so practise first
assessments.credential: Shareable HackerRank certificate URL for LinkedIn and your resume
assessments.why: The closest coding-assessed credential to API work. Because you get only one attempt, take it after the chapters and the course.

assessments.name: HackerRank Software Engineer certificate
assessments.format: 75-minute online test, 3 problems covering problem solving, SQL and REST APIs
assessments.why: A role-level certificate that combines the API, SQL and problem-solving skills a backend Python role asks for, from the same platform as your existing React certificate.
